feedback.title: Alpha feedback
feedback.body: Thanks for trying an early version of Thuluth. What worked, what didn't, what confused you?
feedback.messageHint: Please don't include health details about your family.
feedback.thanksBody: Your feedback is on its way to the team. If you're offline, it's sent when you reconnect.
feedback.privacy: Feedback goes to the Thuluth team with the app version, phone type and language. Please keep family health details out of it.
